info.title: DB Manager API
info.description: Unified administration, monitoring, security and performance analysis for heterogeneous relational databases. Authenticate with `POST /api/v1/auth/login`; unsafe methods require the `X-CSRF-Token` header (value of the `dbm_csrf` cookie).

get.description:
Ready = the application database is reachable and migrated.

The time-series database is reported separately and does **not** make the backend
unready: without it inventory, administration and security features keep working and
monitoring degrades to "Monitoring Storage Unavailable".
